scope: Seven complete native/raw parsers on each of three May RU platforms, plus each actual modern two-argument combined root parser (790 instructions) and complete actual callers. Six subclass parsers are absent from modern optimized classes; no matching helpers are invented. Whole literal instructions, branches, locals, handlers, declarations and full differences remain. Typed aliases bind actual members with full declarations. Three constructor pairs per platform preserve generic raw ABIs and explicit constant/slot adapters; all seven raw call sites per platform prove the specialized argument domain. Modern meta constructor also removes constant long reference 2; its full body/ABI is retained rather than asserted equal for arbitrary reference values. These adapters are not normalization of generic parser behavior. Complete body equality is asserted only where explicitly recorded. Runtime evidence and external capture boundaries are in source-packet-parsers.json and source-packet-root.json. No product source changes or whole-program equivalence are claimed.
